Paths are not remapped. Offline folders and profile sources are kept. Media that cannot be verified is skipped; existing unsafe media favorites are retained even in Replace mode. Passwords, fingerprints and SAF permissions are not restored. No photos or videos are included.

Remove %1$d media favorite relationships, %2$d folder relationships and %3$d photo profiles. Corresponding supported settings will be replaced; omitted allowlisted values revert to defaults. Device security stays local. Actual media files will not be deleted. Continue?
